name: Butterfly Edufields 10-in-1 STEM Robotics Kit for Kids Ages 8-14

specs.Components: 100+ parts (wires, switches, motors, connectors, LED modules)
specs.Key Features: Build 10 working robots, Illustrated step-by-step building guide, Electronic logic & automation learning

subaspects: unclear instructions and poor fitting parts
modular electronics and variety of projects
flimsy balsa wood stands and connector stiffness
debate due to missing items and assembly frustration
Reasonable price for 10-in-1 robot project variety

5_star.title: Good for students
5_star.body: Nice robotic tool kit for beginners.

5_star.author: Deepak
5_star.title: A very good electronic tool kit for kids
5_star.body: Very interesting robotic kit for kids interested in electronics.

4_star.author: Noah
4_star.title: Creative ideas
4_star.body: Original had faulty LED replaced promptly. Parts are a bit fragile and instructions had minor error on alarm bell connection. Overall creative idea.

2_star.author: DE
2_star.title: Neat idea hamstrung by cheap materials
2_star.body: Balsa wood parts are flimsy and screw holes don't align precisely. Connectors are stiff for 8-year-olds.

1_star.body: Not even one project works. Jumper wires wobble and lose connection.
